question: I can probably guess the answer, but... which man is the one you'd least want to have a relationship with?
answer:
Regulus-san.

There's really no other choice (laughs). Regulus-san is the ultimate example of a man with completely broken morals, at least within the limits of what I can imagine. I can't have a relationship with someone who has no morals. If you dated him and married him, I think Regulus-san would be the one most likely to make your life miserable.
